title: State Daily-Rent Conventions for Lease Term Agreement Exit Notice Charges
content:
For an insufficient notice charge on a lease-break request against a Lease Term Agreement, the daily rent is worked out by the convention of the community's state: in California and Washington the contracted rent is divided by 30; in Texas and Georgia the contracted rent times 12 is divided by 364; in every other state the contracted rent times 12 is divided by 365; in each case the daily rent is rounded half up to the cent before it is used.

The community's state is the state recorded on the Apartment Home Lease.

| Community state | Daily rent |
|---|---|
| California, Washington | contracted rent divided by 30 |
| Texas, Georgia | contracted rent multiplied by 12, divided by 364 |
| Colorado, Arizona and any other state | contracted rent multiplied by 12, divided by 365 |

Each daily rent is rounded half up to the cent before it is multiplied by anything.

## Worked daily rents (hypothetical contracted rent of 1,820.00 dollars)

| State | Working | Daily rent |
|---|---|---|
| California | 1,820.00 divided by 30 is 60.666… | 60.67 |
| Texas | 1,820.00 multiplied by 12 is 21,840.00; divided by 364 is 60.00 | 60.00 |
| Colorado | 21,840.00 divided by 365 is 59.835… | 59.84 |
